lines.s0: This image shows NASA’s SLS (Space Launch System) and Orion spacecraft rolling out of the Vehicle Assembly Building at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center.
lines.s1: (Nov. 16, 2022) -- On Nov. 16, 2022, the Space Launch System lifted off from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
lines.s2: OSIRIS-REx launched Thursday, September 8 at 7:05PM on an Atlas V rocket on a journey to study asteroid Bennu and return a sample to Earth.

lines.s0: This photograph shows a telescopic camera for ultraviolet star photography for Skylab's Ultraviolet Panorama experiment (S183) placed in the Skylab airlock.
lines.s1: NASA Galaxy Evolution Explorer found a tail behind a galaxy called IC 3418.
lines.s2: This sparkling jumble is Messier 5 — a globular cluster consisting of hundreds of thousands of stars bound together by their collective gravity.
lines.s3: ESA Herschel Space Observatory has discovered a giant, galaxy-packed filament ablaze with billions of new stars.
lines.s4: Observations from NASA Spitzer Space Telescope show that filamentary galaxies form stars at twice the rate of their densely clustered counterparts.

lines.s0: Siege of Warangal: Prataparudra surrenders to Muhammad bin Tughlaq, officially marking the end of the Kakatiya dynasty.
lines.s1: At the Battle of Posada, Basarab I of Wallachia defeats the Hungarian army of Charles I Robert.
lines.s2: The Tokugawa shogunate hands back power to the Emperor of Japan, starting the Meiji Restoration.
lines.s3: The United States receives rights to Pearl Harbor, Hawaii.
lines.s4: Russian invasion of Manchuria: Russia completes its occupation of Manchuria with 100,000 troops.

lines.s0: Tetraodontidae is a family of marine and freshwater fish in the order Tetraodontiformes.
lines.s1: The sea otter is a marine mammal native to the coasts of the northern and eastern North Pacific Ocean.
lines.s2: The anglerfish are ray-finned fish in the order Lophiiformes.
lines.s3: The giant squid is a species of deep-ocean dwelling squid in the family Architeuthidae.
lines.s4: Clownfish or anemonefishes are saltwater fish found in the warm and tropical waters of the Indo-Pacific.

lines.s0: NASA flight director Mike Lammers provides an overview of spacewalks, also known as extravehicular activities.
lines.s1: During their time on the International Space Station many astronauts have the opportunity to participate in spacewalks, also known as Extravehicular Activities (EVA).
lines.s2: Mission STS-115 marks the resumption of construction of the International Space Station.
lines.s3: In this 'In Their Own Words' video, NASA Astronaut Steve Robinson talks about his training for space flight and his spacewalking experiences.

lines.s1: Heavy fighting in Surabaya between Indonesian nationalists and returning colonialists after World War II, today celebrated as Heroes' Day (Hari Pahlawan).
lines.s2: Luna 17: uncrewed space mission launched by the Soviet Union.

lines.s0: Abu Simbel is a historic site comprising two massive rock-cut temples in the village of Abu Simbel, Aswan Governorate, Upper Egypt, near the border with Sudan.
lines.s1: Hagia Sophia, officially the Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque, is a mosque and a major cultural and historical site in Istanbul, Turkey.
lines.s2: Newgrange is a prehistoric monument in County Meath in Ireland, placed on a rise overlooking the River Boyne, eight kilometres west of the town of Drogheda.
lines.s3: Mohenjo-daro is an archaeological site in the Larkana District of Sindh, Pakistan.
lines.s4: The Terracotta Army is a collection of terracotta sculptures depicting the armies of Qin Shi Huang, the first emperor of China.
